_comment: Merge into settings.json under `hooks`. Runs formatter after Claude edits/writes a file. Hooks receive a JSON payload on stdin — we use jq to extract tool_input.file_path. Replace {{FORMAT_COMMAND}} with your project's formatter (prettier, black, gofmt, rustfmt). Requires `jq` on PATH. POSIX shell assumed; on Windows use Git Bash or WSL.
